rule_or_step_title: Core Triage Criteria: Developmental Delay and Speech Deficit
matching_criterion_description: The individual must display severe-to-profound global developmental delay/intellectual disability (100% penetrance).

rule_or_step_title: Core Triage Criteria: Developmental Delay and Speech Deficit
phenotype_name: Severe expressive speech impairment or absent speech
matching_criterion_description: Must display severe expressive language deficit alongside global developmental delay.
The presence of mild developmental delay or normal cognitive milestones strongly argues against GTF3C3-related disorder.

rule_or_step_title: Neuroimaging Discriminator: Progressive Cerebellar Atrophy and Frontal Lobe Hypoplasia
phenotype_name: Combined progressive cerebellar atrophy and frontal lobe hypoplasia
matching_criterion_description: Presence of marked frontal lobe hypoplasia in combination with progressive cerebellar volume loss strongly points toward GTF3C3 over other transcriptional or epileptic encephalopathies.
